title: Слова: общение и встречи
intro: Слова для встреч, созвонов и переписки. Порядок — по частоте в английском (список NGSL). В примечаниях — частые ошибки русскоязычных.

items.note: Suggest doing или suggest that…: I suggest meeting tomorrow. Сказать suggest to do нельзя.

examples.en: I suggest meeting on Thursday.
She suggested that we use a different library.

items.note: Make a decision — принять решение, а не do a decision.

examples.en: We need to make a decision today.
It was a difficult decision for the team.
examples.ru: Для команды это было трудное решение.

items.note: Mention something — без предлога: he mentioned the problem, а не mentioned about.

examples.en: He mentioned the problem at the meeting.
Don't forget to mention the new deadline.

items.note: Discuss something — без about: discuss the plan, а не discuss about the plan.

examples.en: Let's discuss this after lunch.
We discussed the design for an hour.

items.note: In my opinion — по моему мнению, а не on my opinion.

examples.en: In my opinion, the first option is better.
Can I ask your opinion about this?
examples.ru: Можно узнать твоё мнение об этом?

items.note: Argue with someone about something — спорить с кем-то о чём-то; argue that… — утверждать, что…

examples.en: They argued about the release date.
I don't want to argue with you.
examples.ru: Я не хочу с тобой спорить.

items.note: Attend a meeting — без предлога: attend the meeting, а не attend to the meeting.

examples.en: Ten people attended the meeting.
I can't attend the call tomorrow.
examples.ru: Я не смогу быть на созвоне завтра.

items.note: Propose — предложить план или идею, официальнее, чем suggest: propose a solution.

examples.en: I propose a different solution.
The manager proposed a new schedule.

items.note: Recommend doing или recommend that… — как suggest. Пишется с одной c и двумя m.

examples.en: I recommend reading the documentation first.
Which library would you recommend?

items.note: Глагол — без for: request access. Существительное — с for: a request for access.

examples.en: I sent a request for access to the server.
examples.ru: Я отправил запрос на доступ к серверу.

examples.en: The client requested a few changes.

items.note: Can you confirm…? — вежливо попросить подтвердить.

examples.en: Can you confirm the meeting time?
She confirmed that the bug is fixed.

items.note: Remind someone to do something или about something. Не путать с remember — помнить самому.

examples.en: Please remind me to call the client.
He reminded us about the deadline.
